prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1246; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the collision. Over three visits, care followed a typical course of evaluation, conservative management, and progressive rehabilitation, with treatment intensity tapering as symptoms improved. Physical examination findings were consistent with the reported injury, and imaging clearly confirmed the shoulder injury. No prior injury or treatment to the same body region is known to the provider. Billed services reflect the visits rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Current status: improving, with a plan for home exercise and follow-up as needed.
